jobs.title: Director, AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Technology Services

Technology Services (TS) is responsible for delivering all enterprise infrastructure, applications and related end user technology services across all Brookfield business groups.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Role Summary

Leads the design of enterprise AI solutions that align business priorities, data foundations, architecture standards, and platform capabilities. This role translates complex business needs into scalable, secure, and governed AI solution designs, including GenAI and agent-based use cases. Partners with business, product, data, engineering, security, and governance teams to move high-value AI solutions from concept to production.

Key Responsibilities

Assess business problems and define end-to-end AI solution architectures aligned to enterprise priorities
Translate product and business requirements into scalable, secure, and supportable AI designs
Define architecture patterns for AI, GenAI, retrieval-based, and agent-enabled solutions
Ensure solution designs are grounded in trusted data, integration, and platform architecture standards
Partner with product owners, data architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to shape implementation roadmaps
Guide technology selection, integration patterns, and design decisions across AI solution components
Establish non-functional requirements for security, governance, performance, resiliency, and supportability
Ensure AI solutions align with responsible AI, risk, compliance, and control requirements Review and govern solution designs through architecture checkpoints and design standards
Support pilots, production deployments, and architecture evolution based on business feedback and operational learnings

Required Experience

10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, data architecture, or AI-related roles
Proven experience designing and delivering complex enterprise technology solutions across multiple systems and stakeholders
Experience with AI, machine learning, GenAI, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments
Experience working with cloud platforms, enterprise data ecosystems, APIs, and integration patterns
Experience operating in regulated, security-conscious, or highly governed enterprise environments
Experience partnering with business leaders to translate strategic priorities into architecture designs

Skills & Qualifications

Technical knowledge and systems expertise: Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, AI and machine learning, GenAI, data platforms, integration patterns, and the data foundations required for scalable AI and agent-based solutions.
Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to assess complex business and technical challenges and translate them into scalable, practical, and governed solution designs.
Communication and collaboration capabilities: Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional influence skills.
Ability to work in cross-functional or global teams: Experience operating across global teams and aligning business, product, architecture, engineering, security, and governance stakeholders.
Understanding of technology governance, security, or operational practices: Strong understanding of responsible AI, risk management, security, compliance, and operational design requirements for enterprise AI solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services, asset management, or similarly complex industries
Experience designing AI solutions that support decision-making, workflow automation, or knowledge-based use cases
Familiarity with modern cloud-based data and AI platforms and MLOps or model operations practices
Experience with architecture governance, design review processes, or enterprise architecture frameworks
Exposure to retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge architectures, or agent orchestration patterns

Salary Range: $150,000 - $185,000 CAD

New Position

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Specialty Technology Solutions
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

McKesson is seeking a strategic and innovative Senior Director, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud & Patient Support Program Solutions to lead enterprise-scale transformation initiatives supporting patient services, commercial operations, and healthcare engagement programs. This leader will drive the vision, delivery, and optimization of Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud solutions while building scalable Patient Support Program (PSP) capabilities that enhance patient access, adherence, and outcomes.

The role combines executive leadership, service management, platform modernization, data migration strategy, and cross-functional business transformation to deliver measurable value across life sciences and healthcare ecosystems.

What You'll Do

Lead strategy, roadmap, and execution for Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and Patient Support Program solutions.
Drive enterprise service management practices to improve operational performance, customer experience, and business outcomes.
Establish scalable Patient Support Program capabilities supporting patient onboarding, adherence, access, affordability, and engagement.
Define and oversee enterprise data migration, data quality, governance, and integration strategies across CRM and healthcare platforms.
Partner with business, technology, compliance, and operations leaders to align platform investments with organizational priorities.
Lead large-scale digital transformation initiatives, including platform modernization, cloud adoption, automation, and process optimization.
Manage strategic vendor relationships, delivery partners, budgets, forecasts, and investment planning.
Build high-performing teams through talent development, succession planning, leadership coaching, and organizational excellence.

Basic Requirements

13+ years of professional experience, including 6+ years leading large technology, digital transformation, or healthcare solutions organizations.
Experience leading Salesforce platforms, including Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Service Cloud, or related CRM solutions.
Proven experience delivering Patient Support Program, Patient Services, Patient Engagement, or Specialty Pharmacy technology solutions.
Demonstrated leadership of enterprise-scale technology programs, transformation initiatives, and cross-functional teams.
Experience developing and executing data migration strategies, data governance frameworks, and enterprise integration initiatives.
Strong financial leadership experience managing budgets, forecasts, resource planning, and business cases.
Experience working with executive leadership to define strategy and drive organizational change.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Skills/Experience

Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud implementation and optimization experience.
Knowledge of pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, specialty pharmacy, or patient services ecosystems.
Experience with service management frameworks such as ITIL and operational excellence practices.
Experience with CRM modernization, customer engagement platforms, and omnichannel healthcare solutions.
Understanding of healthcare data, compliance, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Experience managing global delivery teams, consulting partners, and strategic vendors.
Salesforce certifications and advanced cloud platform expertise.
Master's degree in Business, Technology, Healthcare Administration, or related field.

Travel, Work Environment & Physical Requirements

Ability to travel up to 25% based on business needs.
Hybrid or remote work environment with periodic onsite leadership, planning, and stakeholder meetings.
Ability to perform standard office and computer-based work activities.

jobs.title: Head of Finance - Gaming Agency and Publisher
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a full time head of finance to help strengthen the financial foundation of VAL, which has been in operations for 10 years. This is an all remote role. Candidates must be located in Canada.

Candidates who do not have at least one of the following backgrounds - agency, gaming, or publishing experience will not be considered.

The Virtual Athletics League (VAL) is an both startup, leading agency in the VR space, and a publisher. We have the same network of investors who backed Tesla, Hotmail, and Skype.

We have worked directly with Meta on many supported projects including some of the most high profile in VR. Previously we have worked with Nerf, The Walking Dead, Metro, Alien, Hello Neighbor, and others like Gorilla Tag.

This is not a pure bookkeeping or controller role or day to day finance tasks.

Candidates who understand the modern challenges of gaming businesses and the VR industry are given the highest priority.

The ideal candidate has financial clarity, structure, and judgment while also helping mentor the team and experience in pricing and building robust invoice collection systems.

This is a leadership role. We are looking for those with a heart for team dynamics and growth.

The ideal person has experience in gaming agencies, service businesses project-based or retainer-based revenue environments companies. We are looking for someone with a keen eye for cash flow, forecasting, margins, and operational decision-making.

Core job duties

Building and improving core financial structures, reporting, and forecasting
Helping ensure the company has the right finance systems and rhythms in place
Advising on cash flow, budgeting, profitability, and planning
Bringing sharper visibility into margins, revenue quality, and financial decision-making
Supporting leadership with strategic financial thinking, not just historical reporting
Mentoring internal team members and helping improve finance-related accountability and maturity
Identifying gaps, weak spots, and opportunities in our current finance operations
Leadership coaching, hiring and other people management skills

What we’re looking for

Significant experience in at least some senior level financial position or even front line management role.
Strong command of financial planning, cash flow management, forecasting, and operational finance
Ability to work well in an entrepreneurial environment.
Someone practical, direct, and capable of building order without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
Forecasting experience and ability especially in agencies, gaming and live ops.

Pay is 110,000 CAD per year and starts on a four month initial contract with potential conversion to our EOR/Canadian legal entity.

jobs.title: Assistant Director, Digital Marketing - Client Engagement & Automation
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Winning isn’t just about the close. It’s about how organizations experience our differentiated value proposition at the beginning and across the middle that will ultimately define our future success as a professional services firm. Getting there means delivering meaningful touchpoints in the right ways and at the right time to create distinctly personal content and joined-up experiences for clients and potential clients that help answer the big questions they’re asking every single day.

As the Assistant Director, Client Engagement & Automation,
you will play a key role in transforming how EY engages prospects and clients, nurtures relationships, and drives meaningful business outcomes. Your expertise in marketing automation, client engagement, and data-driven customer experiences will be at the core of this role.

We’re seeking a leader who can lead a team of Marketo automation specialists, oversee marketing contact management strategy, enhance customer journeys, and develop scalable engagement programs that deliver measurable impact. Using marketing technology, data, and insights, you’ll create seamless, personalized experiences across digital channels and virtual and in-person events, while measuring engagement throughout the prospect and client lifecycle.

Beyond the day-to-day responsibilities, you'll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and customer experience. You'll bring curiosity, innovation, and a continuous improvement mindset to evolve how EY engages audiences and strengthen relationships. Success in this role will come from understanding how prospects and clients interact with our brand, identifying what drives engagement, and designing meaningful experiences that build trust and loyalty over time. Through your leadership, we'll better connect data, automation, content and experiences to deliver highly personalized journeys, improve marketing effectiveness, and elevate the impact of both virtual and in-person events.

If you're passionate about using technology, data, and automation to create exceptional client experiences and help shape the future of marketing engagement, we'd love to hear from you.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of Marketo automation specialists responsible for campaign execution and operational excellence.
Develop, implement and optimize engagement programs that nurture prospects and strengthen client relationships throughout the lifecycle.
Establish and oversee contact management strategies, ensuring data quality, segmentation standards, and compliance with privacy regulations.
Create personalized, multi-channel journeys that improve engagement, conversion, and client experience.
Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to assess campaign effectiveness and engagement trends.
Partner with marketing teams to deliver lead nurturing programs, scoring models, and pipeline acceleration initiatives.
Support virtual and in-person event strategies, including registration journeys, attendee communications, engagement tracking, and post-event follow-up.
Continuously evaluate and streamline marketing processes to improve scalability, efficiency, and effectiveness.
Serve as a key partner to stakeholders across the organization to align engagement strategies with business objectives.
Stay current on emerging trends, AI capabilities, and Martech solutions to drive continuous innovation and improvement.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Ability to think strategically and connect client engagement initiatives to broader business and growth objectives.
Deep expertise in marketing automation platforms, including campaign management, audience segmentation, lead nurturing, and reporting.
Strong understanding of customer journey mapping and experience design across digital and event touchpoints.
Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and leadership levels.
Excellent project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver complex initiatives.
Curiosity and a passion for innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and articulate business value.
Client-centric approach focused on delivering personalized, relevant, and impactful experiences that strengthen engagement and loyalty.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing or Business Administration
Proven Experience delivering cross-channel, demand generation campaigns for leading brands
Must have extensive hands on experience with Marketo or a similar automation tool
Strong hands on experience in media planning and buying with in-depth knowledge of search and programmatic advertising
In-depth knowledge of martech capabilities spanning platforms (Google, LinkedIn, Twitter, Marketo, email marketing, CRM, etc.), production (content marketing, SEM/PPC, marketing automation, SEO, benchmarking, media plan design, etc.) and measurement (analytics, dashboarding, reporting, etc.)
Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret complex data, uncover actionable insights, and connect findings to customer needs and business objectives

What We Offer

At EY, our Total Rewards package supports our commitment to creating a leading people culture built on high-performance teaming, where everyone can achieve their potential and contribute to building a better working world for our people, our clients and our communities. We offer a competitive compensation package where you'll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage, a defined contribution pension plan, a vacation policy, firm-paid days, statutory holidays and paid personal days based on province of residence, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

Toronto/London/Ottawa/Waterloo: $94,100 to $144,100
Dieppe: $84,800 to $134,800

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.title: Director, Planning
jobs.description:
Job Description

As Director, Planning, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and performance of all planning activities across shipbuilding and ship repair programs. This role will ensure that integrated, credible, and risk-informed plans are developed, maintained, and used as key management tools to support on-time and efficient project delivery.

You will provide functional leadership to the planning organization, establish standards and best practices, and work closely with the Project Management, Operations, Engineering, and Finance Departments, as well as senior management, to support decision-making at both the project and portfolio levels.

More Specifically, You Will

Define and lead the enterprise planning strategy, including standards, methodologies, tools, and governance across all programs.
Ensure project and program plans accurately reflect execution strategy, contractual commitments, scope, and project maturity, while maintaining planning integrity, consistency, and compliance throughout the organization.
Provide executive oversight of integrated program and project planning activities, including milestones, sequencing, critical interfaces, constraints, and recovery strategies.
Assess planning performance, trends, and risks at the portfolio level, proactively identifying leading indicators and escalating material issues with clear, actionable recommendations to senior management.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure planning quality, predictability, readiness, and delivery performance.
Ensure robust progress measurement, forecasting, and alignment with cost, earned value, and project controls reporting to support informed management decisions.
Oversee the evaluation of planning impacts related to changes, delays, claims, and replanning activities, ensuring risks, assumptions, and recovery scenarios are clearly articulated and supported by credible analysis.
Lead and develop the planning organization, ensuring appropriate capabilities, capacity, and succession planning are in place to support current and future programs.
Set clear expectations for performance, accountability, and continuous improvement, and attract, retain, and develop senior planning talent.
Act as the senior planning authority and trusted advisor to senior management.

Qualifications

Ten to fifteen (10–15) years of progressive experience in planning, project controls, or a related field, including at least five (5) years in a supervisory role.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
Significant experience supporting large‑scale shipbuilding and/or ship repair projects is a strong asset.
Strong knowledge and demonstrated ability to apply project controls principles and methodologies aligned with AACEI and PMI (PMBOK) standard practices.
Sound understanding of project delivery phases and associated activities and deliverables.
Working knowledge of Earned Value Measurement (EVM – ANSI/EIA-748-B) in engineering, procurement, and construction.
Working knowledge of risk management principles and methodologies.
Demonstrated understanding of the interrelationships between good technical project scope definition, planning quality, estimating, construction sequencing, execution strategy, procurement and contracting strategies, commissioning, and start-up.
Ability to manage the impact of changes and trends related to budget control and ETC and EAC analysis.
Strong understanding of cross-functional interfaces with engineering, supply chain (materials and subcontracts), construction, safety, quality, finance and accounting, and operations.
Ability to work effectively as an integral part of a large team, including the client, engineering disciplines, the senior management team, and third-party suppliers.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with superiors, colleagues, and internal and external individuals.
Bilingualism (French and English). Proficiency in english and french is required for this position, as the incumbent will interact in both languages with our clients, partners, and suppliers.
High degree of teamwork and collaboration with other team members, including fast-paced deadline pressures.
Excellent knowledge of Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, and import/export features.
Proficiency in Primavera P6, or at a minimum, comprehensive knowledge of its use and capabilities in integrated planning and project controls environments.
Good working knowledge of financial systems and project management techniques (planning, budget control, etc.).
Ability to prioritize assignments, deal with interruptions, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment, while producing high-quality work.
Attention to details.
Successful completion of the investigation and security clearance process required under the federal government’s Contract Security Program.

About Us

Founded in 1825, Davie is Canada’s largest shipyard. We build and repair specialized, essential vessels for government and commercial clients.

Working at Davie means embracing vast possibilities every day and taking part in an adventure where every project leads to something monumental. It’s about tackling big challenges with creativity, determination, and passion.

There’s a real sense of pride in being part of the Davie team. It’s not just about delivering major projects—it’s about innovation and pushing boundaries to accomplish something truly remarkable.

At Davie, we forge the monumental
!

jobs.title: Director, Management Equity Finance and Tax – SLC Management
jobs.description:
SLC Management is a growing global asset management firm providing innovative and diversified investment solutions to institutional investors. We are breaking new ground with a full spectrum of solutions for a growing institutional client base of more than 1400 organizations. Our history of organic and strategic growth reflects this commitment with over CA$422/US$304 billion in assets under management (AUM). As a subsidiary of Sun Life, we are aligned with one of the world’s leading financial services companies, and benefit from the stability and strength of that relationship.

We are a performance-driven organization with a deliberate focus on fostering a development-focused, inclusive culture revolving around our Core Values of being client obsessed
, valuing each other
, acting with speed
and having an owner’s mindset
. As part of our team, you play a role in fulfilling our purpose and making a difference. We offer a rewarding work environment that is filled with opportunity for growth where you will be empowered to meet the challenges of a highly competitive landscape.

Visit our website to learn more and for the most up to date AUM information.

SLC Management offers a mix of in-office and virtual work where our employees are empowered to do their best. Generally, employees are expected to work three or more days in-office each week with flexibility depending on their business, client and team needs.

Job Description:

Director, Management Equity Finance and Tax – SLC Management

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU:

As a Director, Management Equity Finance and Tax you will support the financial and tax operations of its Management Equity Plan (MEP). This role plays a critical part in ensuring accurate financial reporting, tax compliance, and stakeholder communication across SLC. The ideal candidate will support the development and implementation of robust reporting and communication processes, within tight deadlines, for the management equity plan at SLC Management. The role will ensure that management receive the information they need to complete their personal tax obligations arising from the MEP program and that the Sun Life group receives the information it needs for corporate tax purposes. As the MEP is complex, the role will require close collaboration with internal and external business partners to ensure the required information and filings are delivered in an efficient and well-controlled environment. An understanding of the different tax treatments for flow through entities (such as partnerships/LLCs), corporations and hybrid entities will be an advantage in being able to deliver in this role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Develop deep understanding of the drivers of income vs taxable income for individuals and corporates in the SLC group to support the MD in preparing MEP-related financial commentary based on taxable income and distributions across the US, Canada and RoW.
Analyze and reconcile accounting vs. taxable income differences and prepare simplified summaries for internal and external stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Advisory

Coordinate with internal and external tax advisors and operational tax teams to ensure timely and accurate tax filings and payments, on behalf of, or to individuals, including US state composite returns for Non-Residents, PTET elections.
Ensure information from SLC affiliates and corporate entities are properly accurate and complete to enable both corporate tax and personal tax reporting purposes.
Support the tax settlement process and partner with SLC and Corporate Treasury on the timing and amount of cash needs.

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a liaison between HR, Finance, Corporate Tax, Affiliate Tax, and external advisors to gather and disseminate financial and tax data.
Coordinate with affiliates, external tax advisors and SLF Corporate Tax team to understand the various data needs and develop a robust data repository to efficiently and effectively share information between parties.
Prepare quarterly tax analysis and commentary to support MEP participant communication, filings and payments on account.

Process Optimization

Contribute to the development and implementation of streamlined reporting and communication processes. Systems have already been selected and are being implemented, you must ensure systems generate synergies.
Identify opportunities to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of tax provision and settlement workflows.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED:

CPA or equivalent designation strongly preferred.
8+ years of experience in finance or tax roles, ideally within asset management or financial services and ideally with a strong tax component to their work
Strong curiosity, desire to learn and resilience - this is a multi-disciplinary role requiring understanding of finance, tax and legal structures across different jurisdictions (mainly US and Canada but also others, particularly the UK)
Experience working with tax-transparent entities and the tax reporting associated with them is a strong benefit
Strong understanding of tax-to-IFRS differences and legal entity structures
Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

The base salary range for this Director-level role is $110,000–$150,000 CAD.

The upper end of the posted range reflects compensation levels applicable to Senior Director roles.

Why SLC Management?

Opportunity to work for a growing global institutional asset manager
Excellent benefits and wellness programs to support the three pillars of your well-being – mental, physical and financial – including generous vacation and sick time, market-leading maternity, parental and adoption leave top up program, a partially-paid sabbatical program and much more
Pension, stock and savings programs with an employer-paid match to help build and enhance your future financial security
A flexible work environment with a friendly, caring, collaborative and inclusive culture focused on career growth development #WeWinAsATeam
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential
Award winning workplace culture - Great Place to Work® Certified in Canada and the U.S., “Best Places to Work” by Glassdoor, Award for Excellence for Mental Health at Work, “Best Places to Work in Money Management” by Pension & Investments

SLC Management is a regulated business, and this means that there are certain financial reporting and trading preclearance requirements for all employees. Successful candidates will be required to declare personal investment accounts and securities investments as well as seek preclearance on future transactions including those of household members.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Director, Digital Marketing Operations
new_jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Work Arrangement:
This is a hybrid position requiring candidates to work on-site at least 2 days per week at our office in Mississauga. The remaining days may be worked remotely, subject to team and business needs.

About the Role (Job Summary):

The Sr. Director, Digital Marketing Operations is responsible for shaping and executing the organization's digital platform and marketing technology strategy. This leader oversees digital products, marketing platforms, operational processes, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-performing digital experiences that support business growth and customer engagement.

This role combines strategic leadership, digital product management, marketing technology (MarTech) expertise, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making. The successful candidate will partner closely with Marketing, Technology, Digital Product, and Business leaders to optimize platforms, improve operational effectiveness, and advance digital transformation initiatives.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities):

Digital Strategy & Leadership:

Develop and execute a multi-year digital platform and marketing technology strategy aligned with organizational and commercial objectives.
Establish strategic priorities, operational standards, performance metrics, and governance frameworks for digital marketing operations.
Lead and develop high-performing teams, fostering collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Digital Product & Platform Management:

Own the roadmap and lifecycle management of digital products, including websites, mobile applications, and other marketing-enabled platforms.
Partner with Technology and Digital Product teams to prioritize enhancements, ensure platform reliability, and deliver exceptional user experiences.
Represent business stakeholder requirements throughout planning, development, testing, and deployment activities.

Marketing Technology & Operations:

Oversee the selection, implementation, integration, and optimization of marketing technology solutions, including CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, content management systems, and analytics platforms.
Establish operational processes and governance to support the efficient deployment of marketing content across owned digital channels.
Drive operational excellence through process improvement initiatives and automation opportunities.

Analytics & Performance Optimization:

Evaluate performance metrics, customer insights, and digital analytics to measure effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
Translate data into actionable recommendations that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving digital best practices to maintain a competitive advantage.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management:

Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and external vendors.
Manage vendor relationships, contract negotiations, service-level agreements, and solution delivery performance.
Influence enterprise-wide decisions related to digital capabilities, technology investments, and operational priorities.

Basic Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, marketing technology, digital product management, or related disciplines.
5+ years of people leadership experience, including leadership of managers and cross-functional teams.
Ability to analyze data and market trends to inform strategic decisions.
Experience developing and executing digital platform, marketing technology, or digital transformation strategies.
Experience managing websites, mobile applications, digital platforms, or enterprise marketing technology solutions.
Experience working with CRM platforms, marketing automation tools, content management systems, and digital analytics solutions.
Experience managing budgets and optimizing ROI.
Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience in healthcare, retail, distribution, or other highly regulated industries.
Bilingualism (English and French) is considered an asset.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Director, Digital Marketing - Client Engagement & Automation
new_jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Winning isn’t just about the close. It’s about how organizations experience our differentiated value proposition at the beginning and across the middle that will ultimately define our future success as a professional services firm. Getting there means delivering meaningful touchpoints in the right ways and at the right time to create distinctly personal content and joined-up experiences for clients and potential clients that help answer the big questions they’re asking every single day.

As the Assistant Director, Client Engagement & Automation,
you will play a key role in transforming how EY engages prospects and clients, nurtures relationships, and drives meaningful business outcomes. Your expertise in marketing automation, client engagement, and data-driven customer experiences will be at the core of this role.

We’re seeking a leader who can lead a team of Marketo automation specialists, oversee marketing contact management strategy, enhance customer journeys, and develop scalable engagement programs that deliver measurable impact. Using marketing technology, data, and insights, you’ll create seamless, personalized experiences across digital channels and virtual and in-person events, while measuring engagement throughout the prospect and client lifecycle.

Beyond the day-to-day responsibilities, you'll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and customer experience. You'll bring curiosity, innovation, and a continuous improvement mindset to evolve how EY engages audiences and strengthen relationships. Success in this role will come from understanding how prospects and clients interact with our brand, identifying what drives engagement, and designing meaningful experiences that build trust and loyalty over time. Through your leadership, we'll better connect data, automation, content and experiences to deliver highly personalized journeys, improve marketing effectiveness, and elevate the impact of both virtual and in-person events.

If you're passionate about using technology, data, and automation to create exceptional client experiences and help shape the future of marketing engagement, we'd love to hear from you.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of Marketo automation specialists responsible for campaign execution and operational excellence.
Develop, implement and optimize engagement programs that nurture prospects and strengthen client relationships throughout the lifecycle.
Establish and oversee contact management strategies, ensuring data quality, segmentation standards, and compliance with privacy regulations.
Create personalized, multi-channel journeys that improve engagement, conversion, and client experience.
Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to assess campaign effectiveness and engagement trends.
Partner with marketing teams to deliver lead nurturing programs, scoring models, and pipeline acceleration initiatives.
Support virtual and in-person event strategies, including registration journeys, attendee communications, engagement tracking, and post-event follow-up.
Continuously evaluate and streamline marketing processes to improve scalability, efficiency, and effectiveness.
Serve as a key partner to stakeholders across the organization to align engagement strategies with business objectives.
Stay current on emerging trends, AI capabilities, and Martech solutions to drive continuous innovation and improvement.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Ability to think strategically and connect client engagement initiatives to broader business and growth objectives.
Deep expertise in marketing automation platforms, including campaign management, audience segmentation, lead nurturing, and reporting.
Strong understanding of customer journey mapping and experience design across digital and event touchpoints.
Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and leadership levels.
Excellent project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver complex initiatives.
Curiosity and a passion for innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and articulate business value.
Client-centric approach focused on delivering personalized, relevant, and impactful experiences that strengthen engagement and loyalty.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing or Business Administration
Proven Experience delivering cross-channel, demand generation campaigns for leading brands
Must have extensive hands on experience with Marketo or a similar automation tool
Strong hands on experience in media planning and buying with in-depth knowledge of search and programmatic advertising
In-depth knowledge of martech capabilities spanning platforms (Google, LinkedIn, Twitter, Marketo, email marketing, CRM, etc.), production (content marketing, SEM/PPC, marketing automation, SEO, benchmarking, media plan design, etc.) and measurement (analytics, dashboarding, reporting, etc.)
Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to interpret complex data, uncover actionable insights, and connect findings to customer needs and business objectives

What We Offer

At EY, our Total Rewards package supports our commitment to creating a leading people culture built on high-performance teaming, where everyone can achieve their potential and contribute to building a better working world for our people, our clients and our communities. We offer a competitive compensation package where you'll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage, a defined contribution pension plan, a vacation policy, firm-paid days, statutory holidays and paid personal days based on province of residence, and a range of programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

Toronto/London/Ottawa/Waterloo: $94,100 to $144,100
Dieppe: $84,800 to $134,800

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with ethical principles and regulatory requirements.

new_jobs.title: Director, Planning
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

As Director, Planning, you will be responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and performance of all planning activities across shipbuilding and ship repair programs. This role will ensure that integrated, credible, and risk-informed plans are developed, maintained, and used as key management tools to support on-time and efficient project delivery.

You will provide functional leadership to the planning organization, establish standards and best practices, and work closely with the Project Management, Operations, Engineering, and Finance Departments, as well as senior management, to support decision-making at both the project and portfolio levels.

More Specifically, You Will

Define and lead the enterprise planning strategy, including standards, methodologies, tools, and governance across all programs.
Ensure project and program plans accurately reflect execution strategy, contractual commitments, scope, and project maturity, while maintaining planning integrity, consistency, and compliance throughout the organization.
Provide executive oversight of integrated program and project planning activities, including milestones, sequencing, critical interfaces, constraints, and recovery strategies.
Assess planning performance, trends, and risks at the portfolio level, proactively identifying leading indicators and escalating material issues with clear, actionable recommendations to senior management.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure planning quality, predictability, readiness, and delivery performance.
Ensure robust progress measurement, forecasting, and alignment with cost, earned value, and project controls reporting to support informed management decisions.
Oversee the evaluation of planning impacts related to changes, delays, claims, and replanning activities, ensuring risks, assumptions, and recovery scenarios are clearly articulated and supported by credible analysis.
Lead and develop the planning organization, ensuring appropriate capabilities, capacity, and succession planning are in place to support current and future programs.
Set clear expectations for performance, accountability, and continuous improvement, and attract, retain, and develop senior planning talent.
Act as the senior planning authority and trusted advisor to senior management.

Qualifications

Ten to fifteen (10–15) years of progressive experience in planning, project controls, or a related field, including at least five (5) years in a supervisory role.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
Significant experience supporting large‑scale shipbuilding and/or ship repair projects is a strong asset.
Strong knowledge and demonstrated ability to apply project controls principles and methodologies aligned with AACEI and PMI (PMBOK) standard practices.
Sound understanding of project delivery phases and associated activities and deliverables.
Working knowledge of Earned Value Measurement (EVM – ANSI/EIA-748-B) in engineering, procurement, and construction.
Working knowledge of risk management principles and methodologies.
Demonstrated understanding of the interrelationships between good technical project scope definition, planning quality, estimating, construction sequencing, execution strategy, procurement and contracting strategies, commissioning, and start-up.
Ability to manage the impact of changes and trends related to budget control and ETC and EAC analysis.
Strong understanding of cross-functional interfaces with engineering, supply chain (materials and subcontracts), construction, safety, quality, finance and accounting, and operations.
Ability to work effectively as an integral part of a large team, including the client, engineering disciplines, the senior management team, and third-party suppliers.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with superiors, colleagues, and internal and external individuals.
Bilingualism (French and English). Proficiency in english and french is required for this position, as the incumbent will interact in both languages with our clients, partners, and suppliers.
High degree of teamwork and collaboration with other team members, including fast-paced deadline pressures.
Excellent knowledge of Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, and import/export features.
Proficiency in Primavera P6, or at a minimum, comprehensive knowledge of its use and capabilities in integrated planning and project controls environments.
Good working knowledge of financial systems and project management techniques (planning, budget control, etc.).
Ability to prioritize assignments, deal with interruptions, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment, while producing high-quality work.
Attention to details.
Successful completion of the investigation and security clearance process required under the federal government’s Contract Security Program.

About Us

Founded in 1825, Davie is Canada’s largest shipyard. We build and repair specialized, essential vessels for government and commercial clients.

Working at Davie means embracing vast possibilities every day and taking part in an adventure where every project leads to something monumental. It’s about tackling big challenges with creativity, determination, and passion.

There’s a real sense of pride in being part of the Davie team. It’s not just about delivering major projects—it’s about innovation and pushing boundaries to accomplish something truly remarkable.

At Davie, we forge the monumental
!
